name: mirage
text: You're right, and I found why. Your wallet ledger adds up: cash $148 + open bets $78 = about $226, against $447 you put in net ($1,078 in, $631 out), so you are down about $220 all time, not up $148. The cause is the daily profit numbers. A winning bet leaves a payout row in Novig's wallet, but a losing bet leaves nothing. My day numbers only counted a market as finished once it had a payout, was graded in the Tracker, or was 3 days old. Bids and engine bets that lost in the last 3 days weren't counted yet (about $236 of stakes), so the last 3 days showed only the winners. Cash rising $148 over 3 days is open bets settling and paying their stakes back, not profit. I'm fixing it now: a market that is no longer in your open positions on Novig will count as finished. I'm also stopping the tracker from re-updating on the phone. Next release will have both.
